feeds.title: GPAC Blog
feeds.description: GPAC is committed to working collaboratively to endorse, support, and empower our global patient advocates by implementing positive changes in each country, utilizing the skills and network of our amazing colleagues. GPAC is working to ensure that every patient is given the proper safety information to make an educated and informed decision about their medical procedures.

feeds.title: Health Avocate Blog
feeds.description: Health Advocate makes healthcare easier for over 12,500 organizations and their members by leveraging a combination of personal support, data, and technology to engage people in their health and well-being.

feeds.title: APHA Blog
feeds.description: The Alliance of Professional Health Advocates is the largest and most extensive professional and support organization for private, independent health and patient advocates and care managers. The goal of the Alliance is to help them start and grow successful practices, to help them maximize their reach, and therefore improve patient outcomes. It is based on the recognition that many of the people with the very best advocacy skills don't always have the necessary business skills which are vital to that success. We help create the balance between advocacy and business.

feeds.title: Care Weavers Blog
feeds.description: We put our passion, skills, and experiences to work serving individuals and their loved ones in a compassionate and dignified manner. Our goal is to collaborate with clients to understand their priorities so we can aid them in making informed healthcare decisions that support what is important in their lives.

feeds.title: EWPA Blog
feeds.description: EWPA offers Mediation, Professional Surrogacy & EOL Planning. I can serve as a mediator in disputes with your family or healthcare provider. I can act as a professional medical surrogate to speak for you when you can't speak for yourself due to a crisis. I also offer help with end-of-life planning & decision-making. My goal is to bring you peace of mind.

feeds.title: Medical Advocacy Plus Blog
feeds.description: Medical Advocacy Plus helps you navigate through the tangled web of healthcare and provides guidance.

feeds.title: AdvimedPRO Blog
feeds.description: AdvimedPRO founder Martine Brousse is a healthcare industry expert with over two decades of medical billing management experience and vast knowledge of the intricacies of navigating all types of payment claim issues.

feeds.title: Gray Connections » Patient Advocacy
feeds.description: At Gray Connections find Perspectives on Lung Cancer, Research Advocacy, and Other Stuff. This blog is a place for me to capture perspectives and new developments in lung cancer (which I have) and the brain (which I used to have). I'll also include notes about my writing, health, travels, and anything else I find particularly intriguing. I confess I'm a curious geek. EVERYTHING techie intrigues me!

feeds.title: Karen Sanders Blog
feeds.description: We help patients and families navigate the dysfunctional, silo-driven, technologically difficult healthcare system with less stress and more peace of mind. Learn more about patient advocacy services, Transitions Coaching programs for nurses, and more provided by healthcare expert Karen Sanders.

feeds.title: Hope Health Advocacy Blog
feeds.description: Patient healthcare advocacy involves guiding a patient through the healthcare system maze. Patient healthcare advocates act as professional liaisons between patients and healthcare providers. By working in the medical field for over 21 years, I have witnessed firsthand how easy it is for issues to arise for patients. The bottom line, my job is to make sure all parties involved are on the same page and communicating effectively while the patient feels they are being heard and their needs are being met.

feeds.title: NShore Patient Advocates Blog
feeds.description: With all the healthcare changes and concerns over patient safety, the average patient and family can feel overwhelmed. Our RN patient advocates are experts at untangling all kinds of healthcare messes and bringing peace of mind to struggling families who simply want the best and safest care for their loved ones.

feeds.title: Regina Holliday's Medical Advocacy Blog
feeds.description: Regina Holliday speaks about the benefits of health information technology and timely data access for patients due to her family's loss. Regina Holliday's Medical Advocacy Blog is a place where faith, art, medicine, social media, and pop-culture collide.

feeds.title: InTune Health Advocates Blog
feeds.description: InTune Health Advocates, LLC works with clients, to help them navigate the health care system, including insurance and billing issues. We partner with and listen to patients and caregivers so they get the health care and support they deserve. We want your care to be coordinated, streamlined, and in tune with your needs.

feeds.title: News - CACHEducation
feeds.description: CACHE is a not-for-profit organization designed to provide in-depth and ongoing training for persons eager to develop the skill necessary to be a professional patient advocate in today's complex health care environment.

feeds.title: Canadian Health Advocates Blog
feeds.description: Canadian Health Advocates Inc. are professionals with extensive nursing, paramedicine, and medical backgrounds. We are a team of Health Advocates [HA] dedicated to helping you or your loved ones navigate the Canadian Healthcare system.
